business_questions: How large is the current defect backlog?
How many defects are open versus closed?
Which priorities and statuses are driving risk?
Which projects are contributing most defects?
How many defects breach SLA and impact customers?
What is the monthly creation trend?

pages.title: Executive Defect Health
pages.purpose: Executive summary of backlog, risk, trend, and priority concentration
pages.visual_strategy: Priority KPI cards and a single trend line

pages.title: Backlog and SLA Risk
pages.purpose: Focus on exposure, aging, and customer-impact risk
pages.visual_strategy: Bar chart for open defects by priority and SLA exposure

pages.title: Trend and Mix
pages.purpose: Track creation patterns and defect mix over time

tooltip_strategy: Use tooltips only for issue count, project concentration, and risk details where drill-through is not necessary.
visual_strategy: Keep the report executive-first: KPI cards, trend, risk exceptions, comparison, and a single detail table. Avoid generic charts for every categorical field.
design_rule: Do not create a chart for every available column. Prioritize executive KPIs, trends, risk exceptions, and actionable comparisons.
